pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Cetiyesu cārikaṃ caramāno yena Bhaddavatikā tena pāyāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.2: addasaṃsu kho gopālakā pasupālakā kassakā pathāvino bhagavantaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.3: disvāna bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ: mā kho bhante bhagavā Ambatitthaṃ agamāsi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.4: Ambatitthe bhante jaṭilassa assame nāgo paṭivasati iddhimā āsiviso ghoraviso,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.8: tatiyam pi kho gopālakā pasupālakā kassakā pathāvino bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.12: tatiyam pi kho bhagavā tuṇhī ahosi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.13: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Bhaddavatikā tad avasari. tatra sudaṃ bhagavā Bhaddavatikāyaṃ viharati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.14: atha kho āyasmā Sāgato yena Ambatitthakassa jaṭilassa assamo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā agyāgāraṃ pavisitvā tiṇasanthārakaṃ paññāpetvā nisīdi pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.15: atha kho so nāgo āyasmantaṃ Sāgataṃ paviṭṭhaṃ disvāna dummano padhūpāsi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.17: atha kho so nāgo makkhaṃ asahamāno pajjali,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.19: atha kho āyasmā Sāgato tassa nāgassa tejasā tejaṃ pariyādiyitvā yena Bhaddavatikā ten' upasaṃkami.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.20: atha kho bhagavā Bhaddavatikāyaṃ yathābhirantaṃ viharitvā yena Kosambī tena cārikaṃ pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.21: assosuṃ kho Kosambikā upāsakā: ayyo kira Sāgato Ambatitthikena nāgena saddhiṃ saṃgāmesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.22: atha kho bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Kosambī tad avasari. atha kho Kosambikā upāsakā bhagavato paccuggamanaṃ karitvā yenāyasmā Sāgato ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.23: upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāgataṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu, ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho Kosambikā upāsakā āyasmantaṃ Sāgataṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.24: kiṃ bhante ayyānaṃ dullabhañ ca manāpañ ca, kiṃ paṭiyādemā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.25: evaṃ vutte chabbaggiyā bhikkhū Kosambike upāsake etad avocuṃ: atth' āvuso kāpotikā nāma pasannā bhikkhūnaṃ dullabhā ca manāpā ca, taṃ paṭiyādethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.26: atha kho Kosambikā upāsakā ghare ghare kāpotikaṃ pasannaṃ paṭiyādetvā āyasmantaṃ Sāgataṃ piṇḍāya paviṭṭhaṃ disvāna āyasmantaṃ Sāgataṃ etad avocuṃ: pivatu bhante ayyo Sāgato kāpotikaṃ pasannaṃ, pivatu bhante ayyo Sāgato kāpotikaṃ pasannan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.27: atha kho āyasmā Sāgato ghare ghare kāpotikaṃ pasannaṃ pivitvā nagaramhā nikkhamanto nagaradvāre paripati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.28: atha kho bhagavā sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ nagaramhā nikkhamanto addasa āyasmantaṃ Sāgataṃ nagaradvāre paripatitaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.29: disvāna bhikkhū āmantesi: gaṇhatha bhikkhave Sāgatan ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.30: evaṃ bhante 'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭisuṇitvā āyasmantaṃ Sāgataṃ ārāmaṃ netvā yena bhagavā tena sīsaṃ katvā nipātesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.31: atha kho āyasmā Sāgato parivattitvā yena bhagavā tena pāde karitvā seyyaṃ kappesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.32: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi: nanu bhikkhave pubbe Sāgato tathāgate sagāravo ahosi sappatisso 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.34: api nu kho bhikkhave Sāgato etarahi tathāgate sagāravo sappatisso 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.36: nanu bhikkhave Sāgato Ambatitthikena nāgena saddhiṃ saṃgāmesīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.38: api nu kho bhikkhave Sāgato etarahi pahoti nāgena saddhiṃ saṃgāmetun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.40: api nu kho bhikkhave taṃ pātabbaṃ yaṃ pivitvā visaññī assā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.42: ananucchaviyaṃ bhikkhave Sāgatassa ananulomikaṃ appaṭirūpaṃ assāmaṇakaṃ akappiyaṃ akaraṇīyaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.43: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave Sāgato majjaṃ pivissati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.44: n' etaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:1.45: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:2.1.6: antamaso kusaggena pi pivati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc51:2.3.2: amajjaṃ ca hoti majjavaṇṇaṃ majjagandhaṃ majjarasaṃ taṃ pivati,
